<thought>From the observed isotopic envelope, the prominent M+1 (≈13 %) and a strong M+2 (≈33 %) peak match the pattern expected for a molecule containing many carbon atoms (giving the M+1) and at least one chlorine atom (Cl‑35/Cl‑37 gives a characteristic ~3:1 M:M+2 ratio). These features uniquely identify carbon and chlorine. No other element shows a distinctive pattern strong enough to be certain.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
